backend/main.mo: Motoko actor defining a Shoe data type and a Map-backed store with functions to add, retrieve, list all, and filter shoes by category.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping each product requirement (homepage, product listing, product detail, cart, about page, etc.) to the frontend source files and components that implement them.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON dictionary providing one-sentence descriptions of every frontend source file, serving as a quick reference for the project's frontend structure.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base stylesheet defining OKLCH CSS custom properties for light and dark color themes including background, foreground, accent, chart, and sidebar tokens.
frontend/index.html: Minimal HTML entry point titled 'Shoes Shop' that mounts the React app into a root div and loads the main TypeScript module.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Defines the TanStack Router route tree for home, products (with optional category search param), product detail, and about pages, all wrapped in CartProvider and Layout.
frontend/src/components/CartDrawer.tsx: Slide-in Sheet component displaying cart items with quantity increment/decrement controls, per-item subtotals, order total, and empty-cart state.
frontend/src/components/FilterPanel.tsx: Filter sidebar component with a dual-handle price range slider, size toggle buttons, and color checkboxes with swatch indicators; emits filter state changes to the parent.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Renders the site footer with brand info, quick navigation links, contact details, and a copyright bar with a caffeine.ai attribution link.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Sticky top navigation header with logo, desktop/mobile nav links, a cart icon with item count badge, and a cart drawer toggle.
frontend/src/components/ImageGallery.tsx: Image gallery component that displays a main image with prev/next navigation arrows and a row of clickable thumbnails, falling back to a default image on error.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Root layout wrapper that composes Header, a main content Outlet, and Footer into a full-height flex column.
frontend/src/components/ProductCard.tsx: Displays a shoe product as a linked card with image, category badge, name, description, price, and available sizes count, with category-based fallback images.
frontend/src/context/CartContext.tsx: React context providing cart state (items, totals) with add, update, remove, and clear operations, persisted to sessionStorage.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that creates and caches an ICP backend actor (anonymous or authenticated) via React Query, invalidating dependent queries when the identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity authentication via an AuthClient-backed React context, exposing login/clear functions, identity, and login status flags.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: React Query hooks for fetching all shoes, a single shoe by ID, and shoes filtered by category from the ICP backend actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet that imports Barlow and Inter fonts, sets up Tailwind directives, and defines OKLCH-based CSS custom properties for light and dark themes including colors, sidebar, and chart variables.
frontend/src/main.tsx: React app entry point that wraps the App component with TanStack QueryClientProvider and a custom InternetIdentityProvider before mounting to the DOM.
frontend/src/pages/About.tsx: About page featuring a brand story section with images, and a contact form with client-side validation for name, email, and message fields.
frontend/src/pages/Home.tsx: Home page with a hero banner, perks bar, category grid, and a featured products section displaying up to 6 shoes fetched via the useGetAllShoes hook.
frontend/src/pages/ProductDetail.tsx: Product detail page that fetches a single shoe by ID, displays an image gallery, size/color selectors, and an add-to-cart button with loading and error states.
frontend/src/pages/Products.tsx: Products listing page with category tab filtering, a desktop sidebar and mobile sheet for size/color/price filters, and a filtered grid of product cards.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration extending the theme with OKLCH CSS variable-based colors, custom fonts (Barlow/Inter), border radii, box shadows, and keyframe animations, with typography, container-queries, and animate plugins.
project_state.json: Tracks project state (version 3) for a shoes shop website, including existing features (homepage, product listing, product detail, cart, about/contact, visual theme) and pending new feature requests with image requirements.
